text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This paper is a species distribution modeling study focusing on the impacts of climate change, land use and land cover (LULC) change, and dispersal limitations on the future distributions of three oak species in China. It is ecological and species-specific in focus, not primarily about LULC prediction or simulation. Although it incorporates LULC data as an input to improve habitat suitability models, the primary research question is species range shifts under climate and land cover changes, not national-scale LULC future prediction. The study does not implement ≥2 future LULC scenarios with spatially explicit national-level LULC projections as a primary objective. Instead, it uses existing global LULC scenario data as a factor within species distribution models. Therefore, it fails the core inclusion criteria requiring primary focus on LULC prediction/simulation and is excluded.)
